channel.description: Latest articles from Covering Katy News (coveringkaty.com)

item.title: Court Document Details: Harris County Treasurer Carla Wyatt Charged With Burglary of Motor Vehicle
item.description: Court documents obtained by Covering Katy News provides details of the Dec. 27 arrest of Harris County Treasurer Carla Wyatt, who has been charged with burglary of a motor vehicle after being found inside someone else's.

item.title: How Personal Loans Can Help Consolidate Debt and Improve Your Financial Situation in 2026
item.description: The average American household carries $104,755 in debt, including mortgages, credit cards, auto loans and student loans, offer a practical consolidation solution.

item.title: 5 Steps for Revitalizing Downtown Katy and Why Taxing Churches Isn't One of Them
item.description: Downtown Katy doesn't need taxes on churches—it needs a real revitalization strategy. This commentary by Covering Katy's publisher provides five steps forward.

item.title: Katy Republican Tamara McFarlane announces candidacy for Fort Bend County Clerk
item.description: McFarlane, who lives in Katy with her husband, Brad, and their three children, is seeking the seat being vacated by County Clerk Laura Richard.

item.title: JJ Clemence running for Fort Bend County Clerk on Republican 2026 ballot
item.description: JJ Clemence, who has worked in private, public and government sectors over more than 20 years, announced Thursday she will seek the Republican nomination for Fort Bend County Clerk in the March 2026 primary election.

item.title: Katy's Venezuelan Community Celebrates Maduro Capture at Weekend Rallies
item.description: Dozens of Venezuelan immigrants gathered outside Mi Querencia Latin Market in Katy on Saturday to celebrate the capture of Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro following a U.S. military operation on Jan. 3.

item.title: Singas Famous Pizza Opens in Katy With Halal Menu Options
item.description: Singas Famous Pizza has opened at 25830 Westheimer Parkway, offering New York-style pizza with halal options and what the ownership team describes as a South Asian twist.

item.title: Kelsey-Seybold Opens Expanded West Campus Medical Facility in Katy
item.description: KATY, Texas (Covering Katy News) — Kelsey-Seybold Clinic has completed construction of its second medical building at its West Campus location in Katy, expanding healthcare services with 60 providers now practicing at the facility.

item.title: Fort Bend plastic surgeon's license suspended after accusations of performing surgery while drunk
item.description: The Texas Medical Board suspended Dr. Azul Jaffer's license following allegations he performed procedures while drunk. Staff found liquor hidden in his clinic.

item.title: Katy man's viral TikTok video transforms Rosenberg jerky business with 33 million views
item.description: A Rosenberg woman's beef jerky business has been overwhelmed with orders after a Katy man's social media video went viral, generating more than 33 million views on TikTok.
